name: abcnotation-tunearch-org-wiki-joe-turner-blues-no-ext-0001.abc
note: NOT Handy's Joe Turner Blues. This is a 1950s wire-recording transcription of a Texas fiddler (Red Williams, via R.P. Christeson) in A, cut time, double-stopped, AABB folk shape. Shares the title and the folk root only. Do not use it for the Handy piece.
